name: Double elimination (two draws, top 2 of each draw to the final)
description: Lose once and you drop to the second-chance draw; lose twice and you are out. In every heat the top half stay in their draw and the bottom half drop (from the Main draw to the Second-chance draw, or out of it). The best 2 of each draw meet in the final. Every rider rides at least 2 heats. The final size is a setting (2 = the two draw winners meet).
basedOn: Double elimination, adapted to heats of 3–4 riders
